audit.whatIsWrong: Level-chart stages carried a closing verdict that contradicted the stage owner (for example a stage marked Illaoi ending "Camille is favoured here").
audit.why: The full-layer phase text was templated; the tail sentence was never reconciled with phases[].side, so the written verdict and the chart disagreed on the same page.
audit.corrected: Each phase why now closes with the verdict that matches its own side field, so early / mid / side-lane ownership reads consistently.

audit.why: Spike stages line up with the real kits: Camille at 2 (Hookshot, 16s at rank 1), 6 (The Hextech Ultimatum, 140s at rank 1) and her Sheen item; Illaoi at Leap of Faith (120/95/70).

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 stage told you to "use the cast's brief untargetable frame" on The Hextech Ultimatum to dodge Illaoi's key spell.
audit.why: Riot's own description of The Hextech Ultimatum is "Camille dashes to target champion, anchoring them to the area" — there is no untargetable window. The kit file's untargetable/channel flags on R are tooltip-parse misfires and contradict the description.
audit.corrected: The stage now says the dash grants no immunity and keys R to being spent after the enemy spell rather than into it.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds timing is stated even though Illaoi sustains through chip damage.
audit.why: Illaoi heals through Prophet of an Elder God (P) per Riot's ability text, which decides every extended trade against Camille's short-trade pattern.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal timing should be named on the page; I did not have a length-legal slot to add it without cutting verified text, so it is raised here.

edits.before: Short shield-window trades. Start W (Tactical Sweep) for the outer-edge poke and heal, or Q for the empowered auto into a melee threat. Do not extend past your Adaptive Defenses shield or your raw HP falls behind. This is a clean skill phase.
edits.after: Short shield-window trades. Start W (Tactical Sweep) for the outer-edge poke and heal, or Q for the empowered auto into a melee threat. Do not extend past your Adaptive Defenses shield or your raw HP falls behind. Camille is favoured here.

edits.before: Hookshot (E) unlocks your wall-dash stun and attack-speed burst. Only take a wall trade when Illaoi's Test of Spirit is down, then peel out on the bonus move speed before he answers. Camille is favoured here.
edits.after: Hookshot (E) unlocks your wall-dash stun and attack-speed burst. Only take a wall trade when Illaoi's Test of Spirit is down, then peel out on the bonus move speed before she answers. Camille is favoured here.

edits.before: The Hextech Ultimatum (R) isolates a target in a 1v1 they cannot leave. Use the cast's brief untargetable frame to dodge Illaoi's Test of Spirit or burst, then focus the trapped target. This is a clean skill phase.
edits.after: The Hextech Ultimatum (R) isolates a target in a 1v1 they cannot leave. The dash grants no immunity, so spend R once Illaoi's Test of Spirit is gone, not into it, then focus the trapped target. Camille is favoured here.

edits.before: Trinity Force / Sheen turns your Q resets lethal and your wall dives become kill threats. Start applying deep side-lane pressure and clearing camps between waves. Camille is favoured here.
edits.after: Trinity Force / Sheen turns your Q resets lethal and your wall dives become kill threats. Start applying deep side-lane pressure and clearing camps between waves. This is a clean skill phase.

edits.before: Level 1 is genuinely even — you both have one ability and no all-in, so just last-hit and bait nothing. The instant she plants a tentacle the lane flips: do NOT walk in to throw a Q, because a single slam hits for chunky damage and heals her, and your passive Adaptive Defense shield only blocks one of those hits before it goes on cooldown. Above all, sidestep her E (Test of Spirit) — if it tethers and she lands the slam, she rips a spirit out, beats it down with tentacles, and out-heals everything you've done. Farm from the edge of her slam range; your W (Tactical Sweep) poke does not trade up against her sustain this early.
edits.after: Level 1 is genuinely even — you both have one ability and no all-in, so just last-hit and bait nothing. The instant she plants a tentacle the lane flips: do NOT walk in to throw a Q, because a single slam hits for chunky damage and heals her, and your passive Adaptive Defenses shield only blocks one of those hits before it goes on cooldown. Above all, sidestep her E (Test of Spirit) — if it tethers and she lands the slam, she rips a spirit out, beats it down with tentacles, and out-heals everything you've done. Farm from the edge of her slam range; your W (Tactical Sweep) poke does not trade up against her sustain this early.

notes: Camille kit file flags R as channel/interruptible and untargetable; both contradict Riot's own description (a dash plus an anchoring zone) and were treated as tooltip-parse misfires, per the kit README. Packet win rate 43.99% over 341 games.
